candidates.summary: The singer says that for years members of her inner circle have been the victims of hacks aimed at stealing unreleased music, photos and videos.

candidates.title: ‘Lili Elbe,’ Opera About Trans Heroine of ‘The Danish Girl,’ Is Timely
candidates.summary: Lili Elbe’s story was told in “The Danish Girl.” Now Tobias Picker’s opera about her life, with a trans opera singer in the lead role, is making its U.S. premiere.

candidates.title: Booker Prize 2026 Nominees: Marlon James, Elizabeth Strout and More
candidates.summary: Also among the 13 works up for the British literary award are the latest books from Douglas Stuart, Gwendoline Riley and Emma Cline.

candidates.title: Lena Waithe Says Goodbye to ‘The Chi’
candidates.summary: Her groundbreaking drama just ended after eight seasons. “I’m grateful that we’re going out when people still care,” she said.

candidates.title: ‘Wham! 10 Days in China’ Review: Pop Music History With a Secret Goal
candidates.summary: The British pop duo Wham! was the first Western act of its kind to play mainland China. This documentary reveals the hidden agenda of the shows.

candidates.title: Sam Smith Opens Up About Engagement, New Musical Direction
candidates.summary: After rising to global pop star status with songs about heartbreak, Smith returns with an album about pointedly queer “requited love,” made exactly how and where made them happiest.

candidates.title: An Atlanta Museum’s New Look at the Civil War Goes Beyond Relics
candidates.summary: The Atlanta History Center replaced an exhibition focused on military history with a reflection of America’s defining conflict.

candidates.title: Beyond Amsterdam and Venice: 6 Delightful European Canal Cities
candidates.summary: From culture in Hamburg to sweet confections in Aveiro, the charms of these places are revealed as you drift down uncrowded waterways.

candidates.title: Late Night Roasts President Trump’s Attempt at Comedy
candidates.summary: “And let’s just say Iran’s not the only thing he bombed,” Seth Meyers said of the president’s performance at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner.

candidates.title: ‘The Saviors’ Review: Childlike Faith, Adult Betrayal
candidates.summary: Bubba Weiler’s new play about two altar boys at a crossroads includes several beautiful performances, even when the line between sweetness and treacle blurs.

candidates.title: In ‘Cat Cohen: Broad Strokes,’ a Comic Faces Death (and Being Basic)
candidates.summary: After recovering from a life-threatening stroke, a fame-hungry musical comedian contends with a worse fate: She might just be average.

candidates.title: Bill McGlaughlin, Who Unlocked Classical Music for Many, Dies at 82
candidates.summary: His public-radio programs “Saint Paul Sunday” and “Exploring Music” were, at their height, listened to by hundreds of thousands of people a week.
